Distributions

BDF supports 25+ distribution implementations. Each distribution is selected via the dist parameter of BDFRegressor or BDFClassifier, and configured via the params dictionary.

Common Parameters

All distributions inherit from BDFDistributionParams, which provides shared scoring and inference options. Individual distributions document only the parameters they add or restrict.

bdf.distributions.BDFDistributionParams

Common parameters shared by all BDF distributions.

Continuous Distributions

Normal

bdf.distributions.NormalMuNormal

Normal-Normal conjugate model (unknown mean, variance estimated from data).

bdf.distributions.NormalMuInvGammaSigmaNormal

Normal-Inverse-Gamma conjugate model (unknown mean and variance).

Student-t

bdf.distributions.FrequentistStudentT

Student-t distribution with frequentist estimation.

bdf.distributions.NormalMeanStudentT

Student-t distribution with Normal prior on the mean.

Skew-Normal

bdf.distributions.NormalMeanPseudoAlphaSkewNormal

Skew-Normal with Normal prior on mean and pseudo-prior on skewness.

bdf.distributions.NormalMeanNormalGammaSkewNormal

Skew-Normal with Normal priors on mean and skewness gamma.

Generalized Hyperbolic

bdf.distributions.FrequentistGenHyperbolic

Generalized Hyperbolic distribution with frequentist MLE estimation.

Count Distributions

Poisson

bdf.distributions.GammaABLambdaPoisson

Poisson-Gamma conjugate model with shape-rate parameterization.

bdf.distributions.GammaMVLambdaPoisson

Poisson-Gamma conjugate model with mean-variance parameterization.

Exponential

bdf.distributions.GammaABLambdaExponential

Exponential-Gamma conjugate model with shape-rate parameterization.

bdf.distributions.GammaMVLambdaExponential

Exponential-Gamma conjugate model with mean-variance parameterization.

Negative Binomial

bdf.distributions.FrequentistNegativeBinomial

Negative Binomial with frequentist estimation (no prior).

bdf.distributions.NormalMeanNegativeBinomial

Negative Binomial with Normal prior on the mean.

bdf.distributions.GammaMSLambdaNegBin

Negative Binomial with Gamma prior on mean λ (Mean-Strength parameterization).

Discrete / Classification

Bernoulli

bdf.distributions.BetaABBernoulli

Bernoulli-Beta conjugate model with concentration parameterization.

bdf.distributions.BetaMVBernoulli

Bernoulli-Beta conjugate model with mean-variance parameterization.

Multinomial

bdf.distributions.DirichletAlphaMultinomial

Multinomial-Dirichlet conjugate model (concentration parameterization).

bdf.distributions.DirichletMeanMultinomial

Multinomial-Dirichlet conjugate model (mean-strength parameterization).

Non-parametric

bdf.distributions.KDE

Non-parametric Kernel Density Estimation.
